column1: # Counterpart map for runtime_guard.sh: which file under the other line's runtime/spine-<line>/ carries a change to a
# file that exists under one line only (9 only on 4.2, 52 only on 4.3). A file on both lines is its own counterpart
# and is not listed. One pair per row, "-" for none; a file with several counterparts has several rows. A change to a
# file whose only counterpart is "-" always needs the Runtime-other: trailer. The guard suite checks that every
# one-sided file is listed and every listed file exists.
# Member renames inside a file on both lines (MeshAttachment parentMesh -> sourceMesh) need no row.
# 4.3 only: the pose split (Bone -> BoneLocal/BonePose, Slot -> SlotPose, <Constraint> -> <Constraint>Pose)
# 4.3 only: moved out of a 4.2 file (Interpolation from MathUtil, TextureRegion's body from its header)
